title: androsace adfinis subsp. puberula
intro: Androsace adfinis subsp. puberula, commonly known as Tibetan rock jasmine, is a species of flowering plant in the primrose family (Primulaceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly its ability to soothe and calm the digestive system, making it a potential natural remedy for various gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of Tibetan rock jasmine include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
